arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test without width/precision
tests = [
    ('a {:f} b', 'a .5 b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 5. b'),
    ('a {:f} b', 'a 1E10 b'),
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    print(f'{s!r:15s} -> {r}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
